page.notes: The woodcut vignette at upper left is an engraved picture of a seated figure and is not transcribed. The initial "V" of "Voniam" is probably the Q of Quoniam, set as printed. The quotation marks "«" in the right margin are reproduced one per line beside the quoted lines, and their exact line positions are approximate. The word "pretiu" and the spelling "difclufæ" are copied as printed; the long s is read as s. The top-right small printer's mark is not transcribed. No page number or running head is printed.
